input.title: Neutralise CSV formulas by prefixing text values with a space
input.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The CSV export treats text values starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@` as formulas. To fix this, text values in CSV exports must be neutralised by prefixing them with a space. This ensures values like `=HYPERLINK("https://example.invalid","Refund")` are exported as plain text, not formulas.
